🛒 CALGARY GROCERY DEALS: Week Ending November 4, 2026 🛒
1,736 flyer deals checked across 6 stores. Here's where your money goes furthest, store by store 👇

📍 NO FRILLS
Overall: 176 deals, top average score (59). Strongest all-rounder.
🥩 RAW PROTEINS:
• $7.99 Sunrise Farms Chicken Drumsticks, 3 kg - works out to about $2.66/kg, a top-scored protein deal
🥬 PRODUCE:
• $0.99 Fuyu Persimmons - LOWEST PRICE tracked, 62% below avg $2.64
• $2.49 Pomegranate - 49% below avg $4.88, best price in town
• $0.99 Cilantro - 39% below avg $1.62
🧀 DAIRY:
• $2.50 No Name Sour Cream 500 mL - LOWEST PRICE, 8% below avg
• $3.33 Black Diamond Cheese Slices 410 g - best price across stores
🥫 PANTRY & MORE:
• $2.29 No Name White Vinegar 4 L - LOWEST PRICE, best across stores
• $6.00 No Name Chicken Nuggets/Burgers - LOWEST PRICE, 25% below avg $8
• $2.00 Coke or Pepsi 2 L - 74% below avg $7.58
💡 VERDICT: Best one-stop stock-up for pantry, dairy and cheap drumsticks.

📍 SOBEYS
Overall: 243 deals, score 58. Best beef and produce this week.
🥩 RAW PROTEINS:
• $7.99 Fresh Medium Ground Chuck Burgers - LOWEST PRICE, 6% below avg $8.49
• $9.99 Boneless Sirloin Tip Oven Roast - 14% below avg $11.61
• $12.99 Sterling Silver Blade/Cross Rib Pot Roast - 22% below avg $16.55
• $3.89 Fresh Steelhead Trout Fillets - 25% below avg $5.18
🥬 PRODUCE:
• $0.99 Gala or Ambrosia Apples - LOWEST PRICE, 65% below avg $2.86
• $1.99 Zucchini or Eggplant - LOWEST PRICE, 8% below avg
• $1.99 Orange Sweet Potatoes - matches lowest price tracked
🥫 OTHER:
• $4.99 Compliments Egg Whites - LOWEST PRICE, 35% below avg $7.69
• $1.79 Nongshim Noodles - 49% below avg $3.52
• $9.99 Nabob Coffee - LOWEST PRICE, best across stores
💡 VERDICT: Go here for roasts, apples and fall veggies.

📍 SUPERSTORE
Overall: 253 deals, score 58. Bulk-buyer heaven.
🥩 RAW PROTEINS:
• $3.50 Chicken Drumsticks - 51% below avg $7.21, best price in town
• $8.88 Beef Sirloin Tip Steak/Roast/Stew - matches the lowest sirloin tip price tracked, beats Sobeys by $1.11
• $9.00 SeaQuest Whole Tilapia 1.36 kg - LOWEST PRICE
🥬 PRODUCE:
• $1.99 Bartlett Pears - 50% below avg $4.00
• $2.74 Yellow Onions 3 lb - 22% below avg $3.53
🥫 OTHER:
• $9.88 No Name Flour 10 kg - LOWEST PRICE, best across stores
• $1.69 Michelina's Entrées - 35% below avg $2.62
• $2.98 Country Harvest Bread - LOWEST PRICE, 15% below avg
• $14.92 No Name Ground Coffee 907 g - LOWEST PRICE
💡 VERDICT: Hit it for drumsticks, stew beef and big-bag baking staples.

📍 SAFEWAY
Overall: 243 deals, score 51. Mostly mirrors Sobeys at the same prices.
🥩 $7.99 Ground Chuck Burgers - LOWEST PRICE | $12.99 Pot Roast - 22% below avg
🥬 $0.99 Gala/Ambrosia Apples - 65% below avg
🥤 $1.00 Compliments Soft Drinks - LOWEST PRICE, 78% below avg $4.51
💡 VERDICT: Shop here if it's closer than Sobeys. Same deals.

📍 SAVE-ON-FOODS
Overall: 225 deals, score 44. Below average, with a few gems.
🥩 RAW PROTEINS:
• $5.44 Western Family Chicken Breast - 48% below avg $10.36
• $3.49 Atlantic Salmon Fillet - 64% below avg $9.68
🥬 $2.49 Parsnips - LOWEST PRICE, 36% below avg
🍞 $2.49 Sundar Naan - LOWEST PRICE, 54% below avg $5.44
💡 VERDICT: Quick trip for chicken breast only. Skip the snack aisle.

📍 CO-OP
Overall: 92 deals, lowest score (42). Weak week overall.
🥩 RAW PROTEINS:
• $3.29 Atlantic Salmon Fillets - 67% below avg $9.94, cheapest salmon in town
• $2.99 Wild Yellowfin Tuna Steaks - LOWEST PRICE, 23% below avg
• $6.99 Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast - 31% below avg $10.07
🥬 $1.69 Celery - LOWEST PRICE, 38% below avg, best across stores
⚠️ Avoid Bubly and Oasis this week. Both are priced well above average.

📍 WALMART: No flyer deals tracked this week.

📝 BOTTOM LINE: No Frills is the best overall stop for pantry, dairy and $7.99 drumsticks. Pair it with Sobeys for roasts and 99¢ apples. Superstore wins on bulk chicken and flour. Seafood lovers should grab Co-op's salmon at 67% off.

🛒 CALGARY DEALS WEEK ENDING NOV 4: CHICKEN & SALMON STEAL THE SHOW!

Big week for meal planners. Chicken breast is nearly half price, salmon is way under its usual, and apples hit rock bottom. Here's where to shop 👇

🥩 RAW PROTEIN DEALS

🐔 CHICKEN: Best protein category this week. Stock the freezer!
• $7.99 Sunrise Farms Chicken Drumsticks 3 kg @ No Frills - works out to about $1.21/lb, a top-scoring deal
• $3.50 Chicken Drumsticks @ Superstore - 51% below the usual $7.21
• $5.44 Western Family Chicken Breast @ Save-On - 48% below the usual $10.36
• $6.99 Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast @ Co-op - 31% below the usual $10.07
• $28.00 Chicken Legs 5 kg @ Superstore - bulk buy at about $2.54/lb

🐟 SEAFOOD: Excellent. Fish lovers, this is your week.
• $3.29 Atlantic Salmon Fillets @ Co-op - 67% below the usual $9.94 (Save-On is close at $3.49, 64% off)
• $2.99 Wild Yellowfin Tuna Steaks @ Co-op - lowest price on record, 23% below average
• $3.89 Fresh Steelhead Trout Fillets @ Sobeys/Safeway - 25% below the usual $5.18
• $9.00 SeaQuest Whole Tilapia 1.36 kg @ Superstore - lowest price on record

🐷 PORK: Decent, but nothing spectacular.
• $4.99 Bone-In Pork Loin Chops @ Co-op - lowest price on record, 6% below average
• $4.99 Ground Pork @ Save-On - 9% below the usual $5.49
• $3.00 Pork Half Loin @ Superstore - right at its usual price, still a solid cheap roast

🐄 BEEF: Roasts are the play.
• $8.88 Beef Sirloin Tip Steak, Roast or Stew Meat @ Superstore - beats the $9.99 Sobeys/Safeway price and matches the historical low
• $9.99 Boneless Sirloin Tip Oven Roast @ Sobeys/Safeway - 14% below the usual $11.61
• $12.99 Sterling Silver Blade or Cross Rib Pot Roast @ Safeway/Sobeys - 22% below the usual $16.55

🐑 LAMB: No lamb deals in the flyers this week.

🛒 OTHER TOP DEALS

🥬 Produce
• $0.99 Gala or Ambrosia Apples @ Sobeys/Safeway - lowest price on record, 65% below average
• $1.99 Bartlett Pears @ Superstore - 50% below the usual $4.00
• $1.69 Celery @ Co-op - lowest price on record, 38% off
• $2.49 Pomegranate @ No Frills - 49% below average

🧀 Dairy
• $4.99 Compliments Egg Whites @ Sobeys/Safeway - lowest price on record, 35% off
• $2.50 No Name Sour Cream 500 mL @ No Frills - lowest price on record
• $3.33 Black Diamond Cheese Slices 410 g @ No Frills - best price across stores

🥫 Pantry
• $1.79 Nongshim Noodles @ Sobeys/Safeway - 49% below average
• $9.88 No Name Flour 10 kg @ Superstore - lowest price on record

🥤 Beverages
• $2.00 Coke or Pepsi 2 L @ No Frills - 74% below average
• $9.99 Nabob Coffee @ Sobeys/Safeway - lowest price on record

🧊 Frozen
• $1.69 Michelina's Entrées @ Superstore - 35% below average
• $2.88 Compliments Fruit Bars @ Sobeys/Safeway - lowest price on record, 24% off

🍞 Bakery
• $2.49 Sundar Naan @ Save-On - 54% below average and the lowest on record

📝 THIS WEEK'S WINNERS
✅ Best protein to stock up on: chicken. The No Frills 3 kg drumsticks and the half-price breasts at Save-On and Co-op are freezer-filling deals. Grab salmon at Co-op while it's 67% off.
✅ Best overall value category: Produce. Record-low apples, half-price pears and cheap celery.
⛔ Skip or wait: Bubly at Co-op ($12.98 vs. the usual $6.39), Oasis Juice at Co-op ($8 vs. $3.77), Tina's Burritos at Sobeys ($3 vs. $1.86) and International Delight at Superstore ($6.46; Save-On has it for $5.29). Also pass on eye of round and outside round roasts this week, since both are above their usual prices.

Happy shopping, Calgary! 🛒
